fit: isolated eugenol and abnormal motor observation in a mouse model
assessment: The official associated project report describes abnormal hind-limb extension after levodopa. The tested constituent treatments did not suppress it. This is not timed gait or ground allspice. The journal body remains unavailable and exact sample identity is unverified.

fit: oral isolated eugenol and rodent motor testing
assessment: The journal abstract reports selected motor observations. The institutional companion describes open-field exploration, rotarod and rotational outcomes. Its methods do not establish clinical walking speed or a ground-allspice effect.

fit: historically contaminated seafood and examiner-rated dysarthria
assessment: The 2023 reanalysis uses the same 197 government survey exposed participants and a selected group of 130 controls. It reports dysarthria in 24.9% versus 1.6%. Species, preparation and clinical Parkinson speech outcomes were unmeasured.

fit: uncontrolled kidney bean yogurt and sleep quality
assessment: The conference report and article describe one 17-person older-adult cohort. PSQI fell from 8.06 to 4.88 over two weeks without a control. The fermented kidney bean preparation, population and global sleep outcome differ from the frozen pinto and Parkinson claim.

fit: whole MIND diet contrast and grouped bean score in diabetes
assessment: The sleep paper favors the diet assignment for adjusted PSQI. Companion reports concern grouped bean score, cardiometabolic markers and quality of life. All share one trial. Actual pinto-specific records and an ingredient-specific insomnia effect remain unverified.

fit: registered pinto crossover with vascular and metabolic outcomes
assessment: The thesis describes boiled pinto consumption. The official registration lists phytochemical, arterial stiffness and satiety measures. The trial completed without posted results and does not register insomnia or enroll Parkinson participants.

fit: registered Mucuna and soybean beverage with planned sleep measure
assessment: The randomized comparison plans sleep-quality assessment in healthy adults. Each drink includes soybean and the active beverage adds Mucuna. No results are published, and neither genus or preparation matches boiled pinto beans.

fit: diagnostic cinnamon smell cue in the community protocol
assessment: The protocol names cinnamon as an odor for identification and provides no odor-specific result or consumed spice contrast. A later presentation gives prevalence. The related PROBE registry has no posted results, and exact cohort overlap is unresolved.
